title: GitHub - impacifist/Windows-GPU-UNLOCK: Windows GPU UNLOCK: RTX3090 UEFI port, Korean no-reset Windows boot guide, verified source and benchmark evidence
html:
English | 한국어

Experimental UEFI GPU unlock and direct Windows handoff, expanded through community contributions.

Success reports apply to specific cards and systems, not every card of the same GPU model. Check the linked motherboard, BIOS and card requirements before building.

GPU Current status Details
RTX 3060 12GB (GA104 / GA106)Hardware success reported; headless USB onlyGA104 · GA106
RTX 3070 Ti 8GBHardware success reported; internal headlessSupported configuration
RTX 3080No dedicated profile in this port; upstream project targetProject origins
RTX 3090 FE 24GBHardware success recorded; internal headless; default profileSupported configuration
RTX 3090 Ti 24GBHardware success reported; headless USB onlySupported configuration

The compatibility guide lists exact build profiles and distinguishes maintainer tests from contributor reports. Results concern their recorded builds; later main-branch hardening has host/build checks, not a new physical boot or recovery test.

The latest tagged release, v0.3.1, is a source-only pre-release. This source tree has changes beyond that tag, including the USB route and X870 profile; those are not a newly published release. Build locally with your own partition GUIDs. Firmware assets and private, partition-specific EFI binaries are not bundled.

Path Display and input Instructions
Internal headlessB650M/3090 FE or B660M/3070 Ti profile; monitors on RTX; display temporarily removed; no T/U/EnterInternal headless guide
Headless USBReported RTX 3060 / 3090 Ti configurations; profile-specific wrapper and child on a FAT32 USB stickHeadless USB guide
Internal AMD-display manual / AutoOriginal B650M profile, motherboard/iGPU display preserved; manual variant requires UExisting internal guide
Legacy USB manualOriginal AMD/iGPU display profile; U once, then Boot Override to Windows without resetLegacy USB guide

X870, B660-PLUS and H610M are not wired into 

Configure.ps1
or 
Headless.ps1
; use the USB guide. USB packages can also be built for the first two profiles, but their recorded internal boots do not validate those USB routes. The legacy USB EFI retains its AMD display requirement. BIOS priority 
USB → Windows
alone does not implement direct handoff.

This example is for the default B650M / RTX 3090 FE profile. For B660M, select 

-HardwareProfile b660m-3070ti
in both configuration and build as described in compatibility. X870 uses the separate USB route.

Read the full guide and recovery procedure before changing boot settings. Use the exact supported hardware, Secure Boot disabled, a fully decrypted Windows C: with BitLocker protection off, and a connected keyboard. The tools do not disable encryption.

Preserve the existing Windows ESP and recovery partition. Prepare a separate GPT FAT32 EFI System Partition of at least 1 GiB, with a letter such as U:. Tools do not create, shrink, delete or format partitions. An ordinary FAT32 data partition alone is not the required ESP.

You need Python 3.9+, clang/lld-link 20.1.8, the pinned repository dependencies and five locally obtained firmware assets. Host integration tests additionally need MSVC/Windows SDK and private fixtures.

From an administrator PowerShell in the repository root:

# Replace the GUID and tool paths with your own values.
.\internal-boot\Configure.ps1 -UnlockDriveLetter U `
  -WindowsEspGuid 'YOUR-WINDOWS-ESP-GUID'
.\research\headless\build-unlock.ps1 `
  -Clang 'C:\TOOLS\LLVM20\bin\clang.exe' `
  -LldLink 'C:\TOOLS\LLVM20\bin\lld-link.exe'

# Stage and append a separate F8 test entry; retain existing boot priority.
.\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -Assets '.\assets' -Register

Without an action switch, 

Headless.ps1 -Assets '.\assets'
only stages files. Configuration and build do not register a boot entry.

  • Save work and fully power off. On the tested ASUS firmware, select F8 → GPU Headless UNLOCK - EXPERIMENTAL.

  • Wait without T, U or Enter. Initial Esc within five seconds skips release and unlock and boots Windows directly.

  • The screen becomes black while the RTX GOP is removed. The child attempts once and the wrapper starts Windows directly. Do not reset between unlock and Windows. Confirm display recovery and measure.

  • Only after that F8 test succeeds, enable default automatic boot:

    .\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -EnableAutomatic -ConfirmedSuccess

That explicit action places headless first and Windows Boot Manager second and disables Windows Fast Startup. Test registration alone does not. Publishing this release does not change the research PC's current default boot selection.

The two Esc windows differ: initial wrapper Esc boots Windows without release; the later three-second child Esc window is after release and cancels into a stop. It does not restore the display or continue to Windows. On failure or if Windows does not return, fully power off and choose F8 → Windows Boot Manager.

.\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -RestoreWindowsFirst

Windows-first recovery is independent of experimental EFI/build artifacts and still works without saved state. Restoring the prior Fast Startup setting needs that state; retain it and backups. Recovery details.

The original B650M hardware run's successful child reported SS0 

0x88888888
, SS1 
0x8
, BME disabled, zero remaining mappings, completed cleanup and one FLR. The wrapper verified the released topology before Windows entry. Windows display recovery was observed by the operator.

CUDA 12.6 / cuBLAS 12.6, 4096 × 4096 Three-run median
FP32 pedantic 22.85 TFLOPS
FP16 Tensor / FP32 accumulation 124.97 TFLOPS
BF16 Tensor / FP32 accumulation 128.93 TFLOPS

Future runs of the benchmark tool also measure TF32 separately. The historical measurements above predate that addition and have no TF32 result.

There is no contemporary controlled locked baseline for this headless boot, so these values do not establish an unlock percentage. They do not establish game or ComfyUI gains, long-term stability, sleep/hibernate resume or repeated automatic cold-boot reliability. Sanitized measurements and earlier results describe separate experiments.

For the other machines' measurements, see B660M Profile 2, X870 USB evidence and B660-PLUS / 3060 USB evidence (controlled locked baseline: FP16 1.88–1.92×, BF16 1.92–1.95×, TF32 1.93–1.94× over two boots). Those results are tied to their reported builds; a later successful build or host test does not extend the physical test record.

Headless is a separate compile-time profile. Exact GPU/PROM/PCI state, firmware driver code, ownership, cold state, immutable selectors and cleanup checks remain. The child logs to files only and rejects physical GOP reappearance or changed console/input interfaces. Ordinary builds retain their AMD display guards. Do not remove checks or substitute a PROM hash to force another machine through.

Path Purpose 
internal-boot/
, 
research/headless/
 Internal/headless source, local build, installation and host tests
unlock/
, 
release/
 Preserved legacy USB manual implementation and historical artifacts
benchmark/
, 
evidence/
 Measurement tools and selected public evidence
docs/
 Compatibility, assets, boot guides and limitations

No VBIOS flashing or Windows driver replacement is part of the procedure. Driver 617.14 was unchanged in the documented run. Host mock tests do not add hardware support. New systems require compatibility reporting and portability validation. A machine inside the hardware-proven envelope can build and test its own local profile with the new-machine pipeline. This experimental workflow inventories NVIDIA display devices, but deep capture is limited to one RTX 3090 / 3090 Ti in the reviewed PCI/BAR state. A generated local profile does not add another verified machine profile. USB write builds require all 19 host jobs and unchanged profile, fixtures and build inputs; hardware validation is still required. Staging the unlock package needs 

-StageUnlock
.

The port and reused core are GPL-2.0-only; EDK2 and separately attributed components retain their licenses. Based on rough2515-hub/rtx3080-unlock-public and Zagitta/gpu-unlock. Preserve LICENSE, third-party notices and change history. NVIDIA firmware, PROM/BIOS images, drivers and CUDA DLLs are not redistributed in this source release.

英语 |韩国人

实验性 UEFI GPU 解锁和直接 Windows 切换，通过社区贡献进行了扩展。

成功报告适用于特定的卡和系统，而不是同一 GPU 型号的每张卡。在构建之前检查链接的主板、BIOS 和卡的要求。

图形处理器 目前状态 细节
RTX 3060 12GB (GA104 / GA106)报告硬件成功；仅限无头 USBGA104 · GA106
RTX 3070 钛 8GB报告硬件成功；内部无头支持的配置
RTX 3080该端口没有专用配置文件；上游项目目标项目起源
RTX 3090 FE 24GB硬件成功记录；内部无头；默认配置文件支持的配置
RTX 3090 钛 24GB报告硬件成功；仅限无头 USB支持的配置

兼容性指南列出了准确的构建配置文件，并将维护者测试与贡献者报告区分开来。结果涉及他们记录的构建；后来的主分支强化有主机/构建检查，而不是新的物理启动或恢复测试。

最新的标记版本 v0.3.1 是纯源预发行版。该源代码树除了该标签之外还有其他更改，包括 USB 路由和 X870 配置文件；这些不是新发布的版本。使用您自己的分区 GUID 进行本地构建。固件资产和专用的、特定于分区的 EFI 二进制文件不捆绑在一起。

小路 显示与输入 指示
内部无头B650M/3090 FE 或 B660M/3070 Ti 型材； RTX 上的监视器；显示暂时删除；没有 T/U/Enter内部无头导轨
无头USB报告的 RTX 3060 / 3090 Ti 配置； FAT32 USB 记忆棒上的特定于配置文件的包装器和子项无头 USB 指南
内部 AMD-显示手动/自动原始B650M配置文件，主板/iGPU显示保留；手动版本需要 U现有内部指南
旧版 USB 手册原始AMD/iGPU显示配置文件； U 一次，然后引导覆盖到 Windows，无需重置旧版 USB 指南

X870、B660-PLUS 和 H610M 未接线

Configure.ps1
或者
Headless.ps1
;使用 USB 指南。也可以为前两个配置文件构建 USB 包，但它们记录的内部引导不会验证这些 USB 路由。传统 USB EFI 保留其 AMD 显示要求。 BIOS优先级
USB → Windows
单独不实现直接切换。

此示例适用于默认的 B650M / RTX 3090 FE 配置文件。对于 B660M，选择

-HardwareProfile b660m-3070ti
在配置和构建中都如此描述兼容性。 X870采用独立USB路由。

在更改启动设置之前，请阅读完整的指南和恢复过程。使用完全支持的硬件、禁用安全启动、完全解密的 Windows C:（关闭 BitLocker 保护）以及连接的键盘。这些工具不会禁用加密。

保留现有的 Windows ESP 和恢复分区。单独准备一个至少1GiB的GPT FAT32 EFI系统分区，字母如U:。工具不会创建、缩小、删除或格式化分区。单独的普通 FAT32 数据分区并不是所需的 ESP。

您需要 Python 3.9+、clang/lld-link 20.1.8、固定存储库依赖项和五个本地获取的固件资产。主机集成测试还需要 MSVC/Windows SDK 和专用设备。

从存储库根目录中的管理员 PowerShell：

# Replace the GUID and tool paths with your own values.
.\internal-boot\Configure.ps1 -UnlockDriveLetter U `
  -WindowsEspGuid 'YOUR-WINDOWS-ESP-GUID'
.\research\headless\build-unlock.ps1 `
  -Clang 'C:\TOOLS\LLVM20\bin\clang.exe' `
  -LldLink 'C:\TOOLS\LLVM20\bin\lld-link.exe'

# Stage and append a separate F8 test entry; retain existing boot priority.
.\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -Assets '.\assets' -Register

没有动作开关，

Headless.ps1 -Assets '.\assets'
仅暂存文件。配置和构建不注册启动项。

  • 节省工作并完全关闭电源。在测试的华硕固件上，选择 F8 → GPU Headless UNLOCK - EXPERIMENTAL。

  • 等待，无需 T、U 或 Enter。五秒内初始 Esc 会跳过释放和解锁并直接启动 Windows。

  • 当 RTX GOP 被移除时，屏幕会变黑。子进程尝试一次，包装器将直接启动 Windows。请勿在解锁和 Windows 之间重置。确认显示恢复并测量。

  • 只有F8测试成功后，才启用默认自动启动：

    .\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -EnableAutomatic -ConfirmedSuccess

该显式操作将无头设置放在第一位，将 Windows 启动管理器放在第二位，并禁用 Windows 快速启动。仅测试注册并不能。发布此版本不会更改研究 PC 当前的默认启动选择。

这两个 Esc 窗口有所不同：初始包装器 Esc 启动 Windows 而不释放；后面的三秒子 Esc 窗口在释放后取消并停止。它不会恢复显示或继续 Windows。如果出现故障或 Windows 未恢复，请完全关闭电源并选择 F8 → Windows 启动管理器。

.\internal-boot\Headless.ps1 -RestoreWindowsFirst

Windows 优先恢复独立于实验性 EFI/构建工件，并且在没有保存状态的情况下仍然可以工作。恢复之前的快速启动设置需要该状态；保留它并备份。恢复详情。

原B650M硬件运行成功子报SS0

0x88888888
, SS1
0x8
，BME 已禁用，剩余映射为零，已完成清理和 1 个 FLR。包装器在Windows进入之前验证了发布的拓扑。操作员观察到 Windows 显示恢复情况。

CUDA 12.6 / CUBLAS 12.6, 4096 × 4096 三轮中位数
FP32 迂腐 22.85 万亿次浮点运算
FP16 张量 / FP32 累加 124.97 万亿次浮点运算
BF16 张量 / FP32 累加 128.93 万亿次浮点运算

基准工具的未来运行也会单独测量 TF32。上述历史测量早于添加，并且没有 TF32 结果。

此无头引导没有当代受控锁定基线，因此这些值不会建立解锁百分比。它们不建立游戏或 ComfyUI 增益、长期稳定性、睡眠/休眠恢复或重复自动冷启动可靠性。经过消毒的测量结果和早期结果描述了单独的实验。

对于其他机器的测量结果，请参阅B660M 配置文件 2 、 X870 USB 证据和B660-PLUS / 3060 USB 证据（受控锁定基线：FP16 1.88–1.92×、BF16 1.92–1.95×、TF32 1.93–1.94× 两次启动）。这些结果与他们报告的构建相关。稍后成功的构建或主机测试不会扩展物理测试记录。

Headless 是一个单独的编译时配置文件。准确的 GPU/PROM/PCI 状态、固件驱动程序代码、所有权、冷状态、不可变选择器和清理检查仍然保留。子进程仅记录到文件并拒绝物理 GOP 重新出现或更改的控制台/输入接口。普通版本保留其 AMD 显示护罩。不要删除检查或替换 PROM 哈希来强制另一台计算机通过。

summary_zh: Windows-GPU-UNLOCK 是一个实验性项目，通过 UEFI 在开机阶段解锁 NVIDIA 显卡算力，再直接引导进入 Windows 并继续使用原版驱动。目前有记录的成功配置包括 RTX 3090 FE、3090 Ti、3070 Ti 和 3060 12GB 的特定主板/BIOS 组合，项目强调成功报告只适用于具体的卡和系统，不代表同型号都可用。最新标签 v0.3.1 是仅源码的预发布版，需要用户自己编译并配置分区 GUID，后续主分支改动尚未做新的实机启动测试。
